en_title: The Next Halo Game From Halo Studios Was Reportedly Still Years Away, Before Microsoft Handed the Franchise to Activision
cn_title: 据称Halo Studios《光环》新作还需数年
subtitle: 系列换了掌舵者
opus_summary: 据报道，Halo Studios开发的下一款《光环》游戏距离推出仍有数年，微软本周取消了该项目，并将系列交给Activision。后者正组建独立团队，开发下一款《光环》正传游戏。

paragraphs.en: The next Halo game from Halo Studios was reportedly still years away from launch before Microsoft canceled it this week.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，Halo Studios开发的下一款《光环》游戏距离推出仍有数年，微软本周取消了该项目。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft continued its Xbox "reset" this week by gutting Halo Studios, leaving a skeleton crew to manage existing games in the series, and handing the Halo franchise to Call of Duty company Activision . Activision is setting up a new team to build the next mainline Halo game, leaving what remains of Halo Studios out of the picture.
paragraphs.cn: 微软本周继续调整XBOX业务：大幅裁减Halo Studios人员，仅留下少数员工管理系列现有游戏，并将《光环》系列交给《使命召唤》公司Activision。Activision正在组建新团队开发下一款《光环》正传游戏，Halo Studios留下的员工不会参与其中。

paragraphs.en: Microsoft also moved Sea of Thieves developer Rare and Age of Empires developer World's Edge under the Activision umbrella as part of the studio shakeup. It made a very different call with the troubled Halo Studios, however, which has seen multiple Halo projects canceled.
paragraphs.cn: 作为此次工作室调整的一部分，微软还将《盗贼之海》开发商Rare和《帝国时代》开发商World’s Edge划归Activision旗下。但对于处境不佳、已有多个《光环》项目被取消的Halo Studios，微软作出了截然不同的决定。

paragraphs.en: According to The Verge , the next game under Halo Studios was years away from shipping, “so Microsoft pulled the plug instead.” The last mainline Halo game, Halo Infinite, launched nearly five years ago, in December 2021.
paragraphs.cn: 据The Verge报道，Halo Studios的下一款游戏距离推出还有数年，「因此微软选择取消了它」。上一款《光环》正传游戏《光环：无限》于2021年12月推出，距今已有近五年。

paragraphs.en: Halo Studios has endured a tumultous time in recent years, with significant leadership changes sparking questions about the future of the company and its games. Staff affected by this week's layoffs have spoken out across social media this week. One former employee took to LinkedIn to say: “I'm a jumble of thoughts and emotions, but mostly relief. I was miserable for the last year and a half and it'll be nice to feel something different.”
paragraphs.cn: Halo Studios近几年经历了不少动荡。管理层的重大变动让外界对工作室及其游戏的未来产生疑问。本周受到裁员影响的员工也在社交媒体上发声。一名前员工在LinkedIn上写道：「我现在思绪和情绪都很混乱，但更多的是松了口气。过去一年半我过得很痛苦，能有点不一样的感受也不错。」

paragraphs.en: Microsoft obtained Halo when it acquired its original developer, Bungie, in 2000. After helping establish the Xbox console with Halo and Halo 2, Bungie split from Microsoft to become independent again in 2007. It went on to work on looter shooter Destiny as part of a high-profile, 10-year publishing deal with Activision. Meanwhile, Microsoft set up 343 Industries, so named after 343 Guilty Spark from the Halo games, to take Halo into a new era.
paragraphs.cn: 微软在2000年收购《光环》最初的开发商Bungie时获得了这一系列的版权。Bungie凭借《光环》和《光环2》帮助XBOX主机站稳脚跟，随后于2007年脱离微软，再次成为独立公司。此后，Bungie与Activision签下一份备受关注、为期10年的发行协议，并着手开发刷宝射击游戏《命运》。与此同时，微软成立了343 Industries，希望由它带领《光环》进入新时代。工作室的名字取自《光环》游戏中的343 Guilty Spark。

paragraphs.en: 2012's Halo 4 was the first Halo game released by 343. It was followed by 2015's Halo 5: Guardians, which in turn was followed by 2021's much-delayed Halo Infinite. Halo Infinite in particular struggled, and this year's Halo: Campaign Evolved, a remake of the beloved first Halo game, suffered problems of its own .
paragraphs.cn: 2012年推出的《光环4》是343 Industries发行的首款《光环》游戏。随后是2015年的《光环5：守护者》，以及多次延期后于2021年推出的《光环：无限》。《光环：无限》尤其不顺利，而今年推出的初代《光环》重制版《光环：战役进化》也遇到了自身的问题。

paragraphs.en: In 2024, 343 Industries changed its name to Halo Studios and announced plans to work on multiple new Halo games that would all be developed on Epic's Unreal Engine. The announcements were unveiled in a seven-minute video shown ahead of the Halo World Championship's grand finals, which showcased the results of Project Foundry — an experimental project designed to show a Halo game built using Unreal Engine. While it was not much more than a tech demo, the video offered a glimpse at a fresh beginning for Xbox's flagship franchise in the wake of Halo Infinite's troubled launch.
paragraphs.cn: 2024年，343 Industries更名为Halo Studios，并宣布计划开发多款《光环》新作，全部使用Epic的Unreal Engine制作。这些消息通过一段在《光环》世界锦标赛总决赛前播放的七分钟视频公布。视频展示了实验性项目Project Foundry的成果；该项目旨在呈现使用Unreal Engine制作的《光环》游戏会是什么样子。虽然这段视频基本上只是一段技术演示，但在《光环：无限》推出后遭遇种种问题之际，它让人得以一窥这一XBOX旗舰系列的新起点。

paragraphs.en: Questions remain over what Activision plans to do with Halo now it’s in charge of its fate. Microsoft has said it’s setting up “a new, purpose-built team that is separate from ongoing development and plans for Call of Duty.” Microsoft has yet to say when the next Halo game will come out, or if Activision plans to reboot the series or rotate it into its schedule of releases for Call of Duty, which hasn’t missed an annual release for 20 years.
paragraphs.cn: 如今《光环》的未来交到了Activision手中，但它打算如何安排这个系列，仍有待解答。微软表示，正在组建「一支专门成立的新团队，独立于《使命召唤》现有的开发工作和规划」。微软尚未透露下一款《光环》游戏何时推出，也没有说明Activision计划重启系列，还是将其纳入《使命召唤》游戏的发行安排。《使命召唤》已经连续20年每年都有新作推出。

paragraphs.en: Rob Kostich, president of Activision issued the following statement:
paragraphs.cn: Activision总裁Rob Kostich发表了以下声明：

paragraphs.en: "We’re thrilled to welcome Halo, Rare, and World’s Edge to Activision. It’s an honor and a responsibility that we do not take lightly. These teams and their games have inspired fans around the world for decades.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们很高兴迎接《光环》、Rare和World’s Edge加入Activision。这既是荣誉，也是我们不敢轻视的责任。几十年来，这些团队和他们的游戏激励着世界各地的玩家。」

paragraphs.en: "For Halo, our goal is clear: make the greatest Halo game ever, worthy of its universe and legacy, while staying true to what made players love it in the first place. It is a bold ambition, one that this franchise deserves. We have already begun assembling a purpose-built team, unique in capability and talent, ready and excited to deliver this next chapter with the community.
paragraphs.cn: 「对于《光环》，我们的目标很明确：打造有史以来最出色的《光环》游戏，既要配得上它的世界观和传承，也要忠于最初让玩家爱上它的特质。这是一个大胆的目标，而这个系列值得我们为之努力。我们已经开始组建一支专门的团队，成员各有所长，已经做好准备，也满怀热情，期待与玩家社群共同呈现系列的新篇章。」

paragraphs.en: "To the World’s Edge and Rare teams, we can’t wait to get to work together."
paragraphs.cn: 「对于World’s Edge和Rare团队，我们迫不及待想与你们携手工作。」

paragraphs.en: New Xbox CEO Asha Sharma is looking to double down on the company's biggest franchises, such as Fallout, Minecraft, and Halo, and release big new games in those franchises more frequently. Activision releases a brand new, mainline Call of Duty game ever year. Sharma may be hoping some of that rubs off on Halo.
paragraphs.cn: 新任XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma希望进一步加大对《辐射》《我的世界》和《光环》等公司旗下主要系列的投入，并更频繁地推出这些系列的大型新作。Activision每年都会推出一款全新的《使命召唤》正传游戏。Sharma或许希望《光环》也能借鉴这种做法。
